quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a sustainable florist using only locally grown seasonal flowers with zero air miles.
quests.correctAnswer: Every stem comes from a local farm, not a long-haul flight, so freshness and ethics arrive together.
quests.hint: Lead with zero air miles as the point of difference.
quests.explanation: Pairing an ethical claim with a freshness claim gives the pitch two reasons to say yes.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a bakery specialising exclusively in allergen-free celebration cakes.
quests.correctAnswer: Every cake is free from gluten, dairy, and nuts, so no guest is ever left out.
quests.hint: Focus on the guest who gets to join in, not the ingredients removed.
quests.explanation: Framing safety around an included guest makes a dietary claim feel personal, not clinical.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a coffee roastery that ships beans within 24 hours of roasting.
quests.correctAnswer: Beans leave the roaster and reach your door within a day, at their absolute peak flavour.
quests.hint: Lead with freshness as a race against time.
quests.explanation: A tight time claim is a freshness promise that supermarket coffee simply cannot match.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a community kitchen renting hourly space to home cooks starting food businesses.
quests.correctAnswer: Rent a licensed kitchen by the hour, and turn a home recipe into a real business.
quests.hint: Highlight the low-cost way in, not just the kitchen itself.
quests.explanation: Removing the upfront cost barrier is what makes a big dream feel achievable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a repair café where community volunteers fix broken household items for free.
quests.correctAnswer: Bring your broken toaster or lamp, and a skilled volunteer fixes it for free.
quests.hint: Use one specific broken item as your example.
quests.explanation: A specific object is easier to picture than a vague promise about fixing things.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a community seed library where gardeners borrow and return seeds each season.
quests.correctAnswer: Borrow seeds for the season, then return a few at harvest - gardening built on trust.
quests.hint: Emphasise the simple borrow-and-return cycle.
quests.explanation: A simple, repeatable cycle is easy to explain and easy for anyone to join.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a micro-savings app that rounds up every purchase and invests the spare change.
quests.correctAnswer: Every purchase rounds up, and the spare change quietly invests itself in the background.
quests.hint: Highlight the effortless, automatic saving.
quests.explanation: Invisible, automatic saving removes the willpower that stops most people from ever starting.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a bill-splitting app that divides shared household expenses fairly between housemates.
quests.correctAnswer: It tracks every shared bill and tells each housemate exactly what they owe - no awkward chats.
quests.hint: Lead with the awkward conversation this app removes.
quests.explanation: Removing social friction around money is a strong, relatable selling point for housemates.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a student bank account that gives cashback on textbook purchases.
quests.correctAnswer: Every textbook you buy earns cashback, turning an unavoidable cost into a small win.
quests.hint: Connect cashback to one cost every student recognises.
quests.explanation: Targeting one specific, familiar cost makes the pitch feel useful, not generic.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an on-demand appliance repair service guaranteed to arrive within two hours.
quests.correctAnswer: A technician arrives within two hours and fixes it, or you pay absolutely nothing.
quests.hint: Pair the speed with the no-fix, no-fee promise.
quests.explanation: A guarantee removes the two main worries anyone has about booking a repair service.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a home energy audit service identifying exactly where heat and power are wasted.
quests.correctAnswer: An auditor finds exactly where your home leaks heat, and your bills drop within weeks.
quests.hint: Focus on the savings you can measure, not the audit process.
quests.explanation: A savings you can measure gives people an easy reason to book a visit.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an interior design consultation service delivered over a video call.
quests.correctAnswer: Get expert design advice over a video call, at a fraction of a home-visit price.
quests.hint: Compare the price directly with a traditional in-home visit.
quests.explanation: A direct price comparison makes an unfamiliar format feel like the smarter choice.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a monthly subscription of vet-approved premium food for dogs.
quests.correctAnswer: Every meal is vet-approved and matched to your dog's breed, age, and health needs.
quests.hint: Combine vet approval with the personal match.
quests.explanation: Expert approval plus a personal match makes the food feel chosen, not just delivered.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an online pet pharmacy offering prescription medicines delivered overnight.
quests.correctAnswer: Prescription medicine reaches your door overnight, for less than your local vet usually charges.
quests.hint: Lead with convenience and the price saving together.
quests.explanation: Solving cost and convenience in one line answers the two biggest pet-owner frustrations.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a pet behaviour coaching app teaching owners to train their own dogs.
quests.correctAnswer: Learn exactly what a professional trainer would teach you, without ever paying trainer prices.
quests.hint: Highlight what the owner learns, not what the app contains.
quests.explanation: Framing the app as a skill you gain, not a tool you own, builds confidence.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a shampoo subscription formulated specifically for your individual hair type.
quests.correctAnswer: Your formula is matched to your hair type and arrives monthly - no more guessing in the shop aisle.
quests.hint: Lead with the personalisation as the main difference.
quests.explanation: Ending a familiar frustration - guessing in the aisle - makes personalisation feel practical, not fancy.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a zero-waste beauty range packaged entirely in compostable materials.
quests.correctAnswer: The formulas perform like any premium brand, but the packaging leaves nothing behind.
quests.hint: Defend the performance before mentioning the packaging.
quests.explanation: Reassuring people on quality first removes the doubt that 'eco' must mean 'weaker.'

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a virtual try-on app for makeup that uses your phone camera in real time.
quests.correctAnswer: See any shade on your own face, live on camera, before you ever buy it.
quests.hint: Highlight the risk-free decision this makes possible.
quests.explanation: Removing the risk of buying the wrong shade is the main barrier to buying beauty online.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a smart basketball hoop that analyses your shooting form using AI after each attempt.
quests.correctAnswer: Every shot is filmed and scored, so you get real coaching feedback after every single attempt.
quests.hint: Lead with the coaching feedback, not the camera technology.
quests.explanation: Promising feedback after every shot gives amateur players a taste of elite-level coaching.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a waterproof wristband that counts swimming laps automatically without any buttons.
quests.correctAnswer: It counts every lap by itself, so you never lose track mid-swim again.
quests.hint: Stress the effortless, automatic tracking.
quests.explanation: Removing a small manual task is an easy, obvious improvement for any regular swimmer.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a golf swing analyser that clips to any club and gives instant feedback.
quests.correctAnswer: Clip it onto any club, and get one clear tip to fix after every single shot.
quests.hint: Highlight the instant, specific feedback after every shot.
quests.explanation: Instant, specific feedback gives amateur golfers coaching that was once only for professionals.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a personalised gift recommendation service for impossible-to-buy-for relatives.
quests.correctAnswer: A few quick questions later, and you have a gift they'll actually love - not another candle.
quests.hint: Lead with the frustration of generic gifts everyone recognises.
quests.explanation: A little humour about bad gifts makes the pitch memorable and instantly relatable.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch an experience gift platform offering unique local activities as presents.
quests.correctAnswer: Give a hot air balloon ride or a cooking class - a memory instead of more clutter.
quests.hint: Contrast a memory with a physical object.
quests.explanation: Experience gifts are growing fast because a memory doesn't add to household clutter.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a charity gift card that lets the recipient choose their own cause to support.
quests.correctAnswer: Let the person you're gifting choose exactly which cause the money supports.
quests.hint: Lead with the recipient's choice, not the giver's idea.
quests.explanation: Letting the recipient decide makes a gift reflect their values, not the giver's guess.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a heated jacket that automatically adjusts its warmth to the outside temperature.
quests.correctAnswer: The jacket senses the temperature around you and adjusts its warmth without you touching a thing.
quests.hint: Highlight the effortless comfort of automatic adjustment.
quests.explanation: Automating comfort removes any user effort and makes the jacket feel genuinely intelligent.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch trainers with replaceable soles that can be swapped when they wear out.
quests.correctAnswer: When the sole wears down, simply swap it - the same shoe lasts for years, not months.
quests.hint: Lead with the years-versus-months comparison.
quests.explanation: A years-versus-months comparison makes the long-term saving instantly easy to picture.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a clothing rental subscription delivering fresh professional outfits for work each week.
quests.correctAnswer: A fresh, stylish outfit arrives every week, with zero dry-cleaning bills and zero wardrobe stress.
quests.hint: Stress total convenience over the clothes themselves.
quests.explanation: Removing decision fatigue and cleaning costs together appeals strongly to busy professionals.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a short-form cooking video platform dedicated entirely to genuine five-minute recipes.
quests.correctAnswer: Every single video is real food, cooked in genuinely five minutes, with no cheating on the clock.
quests.hint: Lead with the credibility of the strict five-minute promise.
quests.explanation: A strict, honest promise builds trust in a space full of exaggerated cooking videos.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a local news newsletter delivering the five most important stories in your town each morning.
quests.correctAnswer: Five local stories, every morning, read fully in under two minutes.
quests.hint: Focus on the time saved, not the number of stories.
quests.explanation: A specific reading time makes a daily habit feel genuinely realistic to commit to.

quests.instruction: Deliver the pitch before the lift opens.
quests.prompt: Pitch a live music discovery app that shows tonight's gigs within five kilometres of you.
quests.correctAnswer: See every gig happening within five kilometres tonight - great music, right on your own doorstep.
quests.hint: Focus on immediacy to inspire action tonight, not someday.
quests.explanation: Immediacy creates urgency, pushing a music fan to act tonight instead of scrolling past.
